strings: Lis & Pavlos wedding is a web development case study by Isaure Lohest, covering UX/UI decisions, implementation details, and final delivery.

For this collaboration with La Invitación de Liana, I created a wedding website that celebrates both craftsmanship and digital elegance. Designed around the couple's vision, the site features a rich blend of soft animations and personalized illustrations, adding charm and personality to every section. Guests can explore the wedding details in an aesthetically balanced layout. A secure password-protected access ensures the privacy of all information, making the experience both intimate and exclusive. A private administration page for the couple includes tools to manage guest responses, export RSVP data to Excel format, and track total attendance.
Illustrations by La Invitación de Liana
